$comment: Barbeque's Delight's grill is the block itself, turned as it faces; its grate is at y 15 inside a rim to y 16. piece_N are its two places, side by side a fifth of a block off the middle as the grill has them (place 0 on the cook's left), each a skewer built from its icon lying front to back, which the cook clicks to turn or take; dressing_N is the seasoning lying on its top (a skewer is 0.53 high), moving with it. mouth catches stacks let go over the grill, grill the clicks beside the skewers; both are thin, at the grate, so a click on a skewer reaches it. hand_N brings a seasoning over skewer N and shakes it out; lift_N are ghosts of what leaves the grill or bounces back. The camera stands to the grill as to the stove, a pixel lower with the grate, and the recipe book hangs where it hangs there.
